title: Robert Reade (Paris) to his cousin, 19 April 1641 (BL Harley MS 7001 ff. 148-149; DECODE R7766)

documents.route: Paris (Windebank household in exile) -> England (the writer's cousin, probably Thomas Windebank)

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the leaves or in print; key is the Deciphering Branch reconstruction DECODE R9115 (Add MS 32256 f. 4).

transcription.notes: Numbers plus symbol letters; three apparent digits (8, 2, D) proved to be symbol letters (phi, reversed c, n-sign) once the key was read.

system.summary: Numerical nomenclator: 1-50 single letters with odd numbers as nulls, 51-100 letters and syllables, about twenty symbol letters, and an alphabetically ordered code of words and names from 100 to about 735.
system.notes: Key: DECODE R9115, BL Add MS 32256 f. 4, 'Windebank to his Son. Paris. March 1642' with 'Windebank's C[ipher] continued 1640', an 18th-century reconstruction with blanks.

prior_solution.where: Not printed or calendared; the key reconstruction exists (R9115) but no decipherment of this letter

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up the coding agent with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched R7766 record and 4 full-resolution images with the session cookie.
Read signature 'R. Reade' and endorsement 'my Cousin Reade from Paris'; identified the writer as Robert Reade of the Windebank household in exile.
Transcribed the two cipher passages (254 groups, numbers 2-729 plus symbol letters).
Tried DECODE key R8694 (Mr Browne, Add MS 72438): codes stop at 371, alphabet gives no sense.
Searched DECODE metadata for Windebank; found R9115 (Add MS 32256 f. 4, Windebank to his son, Paris 1640-42), a Deciphering Branch reconstruction; read both pages of it.
Applied the key: 'in case a proclamation shall goe out against ... they have not enough against him to confiscate his fortune ... refusall to return ...'.
Re-read doubtful glyphs at full resolution against the key's symbol list: 8=phi (s), D=n-sign, 2=reversed c (d), delta (t).
Web search for the letter and a Reade/Windebank decipherment in print.
Filled code groups blank in the reconstruction by alphabetical slot and context (524 return, 562 secure, 573 they, 660 willing; 15 weaker conjectures).

gaps.detail: blank in the only surviving key reconstruction (R9115); conjectured from context and alphabetical slot

outcome.notes: 189/215 significant tokens from key values, 11 from values rebuilt here, 15 conjectured.
